title: KotlinForForge issue #90: Crash in dev on NeoForge 20.4.40-beta (and later) due to changes in mods.toml
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (LGPL-2.1) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by Prototik]
In 20.4.40 NeoForge made changes in mods.toml format (see more [on their discord](https://discord.com/channels/313125603924639766/437004041394847745/1185682777245499412) or in [commit description](https://github.com/neoforged/NeoForge/commit/8786a13b2191ece3265e3c4de9517a7c2f572d3d)), and deprecated `mandatory` field in flavor of `type` field with `required`/`optional` values.
And made it hard failure in dev (dumbest thing I have ever seen, but who cares).

So KFF (which still uses `mandatory` field) no longer possible to use with latest Neo in Dev runtime, but in Prod it works just fine.

[comment by thedarkcolour (owner)]
Fixed in 4.10.0
